Name: Buyable Tropical Curry Recipe
Author: shalassa
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/56075/56075-1795724692-193603101.png[/img][/center]


This mod is for those who don't want to pray to the dice gods for Gus to appear at the Island Resort to sell a single recipe by simply adding it to the Island Trader for the same price as Gus would sell it for (2000 coinies)



[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/56075/56075-1795724692-1357243854.png[/img][/center]


Just copy the extracted folder into ./Mods, or let your mod manager do it for you.
To remove it, just delete it from ./Mods, or have a mod manager do it.



[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/56075/56075-1795724693-802522149.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[left][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/left]
[left]That's all :)[/left]

Manifest.Name: Buyable Tropical Curry Recipe
Manifest.Description: Allows you to buy the recipe for Tropical Curry at the Island Trader.
Manifest.Author: Shalassa
